mapper.select: select m.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId , m.IND_ID indId , m.PORTFOLIO_LEVEL portfolioLevel , m.START_DATE startDate , m.END_DATE endDate , n.IND_NAME indName , n.IND_TYPE indType , n.EXPR , n.SUP_FREQUENCY , n.WARN_COND warnCond , n.FOUL_COND foulCond , n.TIME_POINT timePoint , case when m.PORTFOLIO_LEVEL='02' then (select replace(replace(xml2clob(xmlagg(xmlelement(NAME a, PORTFOLIO_ID || ','))),'',''),'',' ') as portfConst from RSK_PORTFOLIO_PACKAGE_DTL x where x.PTL_BAG_ID=m.PORTFOLIO_ID group by PTL_BAG_ID) else null end portfConstId from RSK_PORTFOLIO_INDICATOR m inner join RSK_ISUP_INDICATOR n on m.IND_ID=n.IND_ID and n.IS_ENABLED=#{isEnabled} and n.TIME_POINT like CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{timePoint}),'%') (m.PORTFOLIO_ID =#{portfolioCode} or m.PORTFOLIO_ID in (select PTL_BAG_ID from RSK_PORTFOLIO_PACKAGE_DTL where PORTFOLIO_ID=#{portfolioCode})) and ( ( (instr(n.SUP_DISPLAY_CLASSIFY,'01')>0 or n.SUP_DISPLAY_CLASSIFY is null) and m.START_DATE <= to_date('${valDate}','yyyy-MM-dd') AND (case when m.END_DATE is null then to_date('2999-01-01','yyyy-MM-dd') else m.END_DATE end) >= to_date('${valDate}','yyyy-MM-dd') and (case when n.ASSET_TYPE is null then #{assetType} else n.ASSET_TYPE end) like CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{assetType}),'%') and (case when n.ASSET_SEC_TYPE is null then #{assetSecType} else n.ASSET_SEC_TYPE end ) like CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{assetSecType}),'%') and (case when n.ASSET_THR_TYPE is null then #{assetThrType} else n.ASSET_THR_TYPE end ) like CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{assetThrType}),'%') ) or ((instr(n.SUP_DISPLAY_CLASSIFY,'02')>0 and (case when n.INVEST_PROPORTY is null then #{investProporty} else n.INVEST_PROPORTY end ) like CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{investProporty}),'%') and m.START_DATE <= to_date('${valDate}','yyyy-MM-dd') AND (case when m.END_DATE is null then to_date('2999-01-01','yyyy-MM-dd') else m.END_DATE end) >= to_date('${valDate}','yyyy-MM-dd') )))
select PARA_CODE paraCode ,PARA_GRANULARITY paraGranularity ,PARA_DISPLAY_TYPE paraDisplayType ,CONTENT from RSK_ISUP_INDICATOR_PARA_DTL where PARA_CODE=#{code} and PARA_GRANULARITY=#{granularity}
select max(SUP_DATE) from RSK_ISUP_POINT_VAL where PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId} and IND_ID = #{indId}
